Are you ready to shape the future of Retail in an AI-first world? Join a dynamic team enabling one of the world's leading Retail companies to drive digital transformation and remain competitive. In our team, you will help activate innovative business models, unlock new growth opportunities for our customers, and create competitive advantage through advanced technologies and strategic insight.

Microsoft's Enterprise Accounts team focuses on empowering customers on their AI transformation journey. This team is responsible for envisioning new possibilities for customers, delivering solutions that drive meaningful business outcomes, and accelerating revenue growth for Microsoft.

As an Enterprise Account Technology Strategist, you will have the opportunity to co-create and lead pioneering technology initiatives with your customers—supporting their desired business outcomes while aligning with Microsoft's business goals.

Alongside an Enterprise Account Executive and by leveraging a large, cross-functional virtual team across Microsoft's product portfolio and partner ecosystem, you will build and expand your network of technology executives among your customers and deliver industry-aligned solutions that help customers adopt and embrace AI technologies.

With a proven record of innovating technical solutions that meet customer business goals and drive account growth, this role enables you to combine your technology and industry expertise to deliver AI solutions that accelerate your customers' AI vision, ultimately becoming their trusted technology advisor.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we innovate with a growth mindset, empower others, and collaborate to achieve shared goals. Every day, we rely on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to foster an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
